text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: gpu-queue-usw2 spike detected. queue_length > 1200, 95th queue latency = 2m12s, autoscaler errors observed. Assigning to #oncall (maria)

maria: ack, I'm on it. @kevin @sasha can you pull autoscaler logs + spot preempt counts? Impacting production inference queues.

kevin: looking now. seeing repeated 429s from cloud API in autoscaler: `RateLimitExceeded`. Also a bunch of preempt events starting ~1961234300. snippet:```2026-03-14T18:02:10Z autoscaler ERROR scaleFail: RateLimitExceeded: request quota exceeded
2026-03-14T18:02:17Z pool-manager WARN preempt detected: instance-spot-... terminated (SIGTERM)
2026-03-14T18:02:45Z autoscaler WARN fallback-start: attempted to launch on-demand but hit vpc quota```

sasha: confirmed spike in preempts. 60% of new allocations in the last 10m were spot and ~40% were preempted within 90s. Reserved fallback pool is at min-size=2 and currently exhausted. No immediate spare capacity in dedicated pools.

maria: OK, two-pronged mitigation: 1) throttle low-priority batch jobs + pause evals, 2) force an emergency on-demand backfill for inference pool. @samir please coordinate with cloud infra to lift quota for on-demand if possible.

samir: on it, opening a support request with provider and trying manual quota bump. ETA ~10-15m. In parallel I'll try increasing fallback pool min size via infra API.

kevin: I'm running the temporary scale-down for background jobs:```# pause background evals
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  https://api.redwood.internal/v1/jobs/pause?label=background-eval
# reduce batch size for user-facing model to 16 -> 8
curl -X PATCH -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model_settings": {"batch_size": 8}}' \n  https://api.redwood.internal/v1/models/rt-medium/settings
```

sasha: also toggled prefer-dedicated=false routing rule so we don't accidentally drain the few dedicated GPUs we have. That will keep dedicated capacity for priority customers.

incident-bot: NOTE: page routed to oncall: m = maria, severity: P1, affected endpoints: /v1/generate (/chat and /stream). Error rate up 3.5x for the last 6m.

maria: initial customer impact check: noisy small customers seeing increased latencies, 4 customers reported timeouts (>30s) in the last 12m. No broad 5xx surge for hosted API, mostly queued timeouts and degraded p99. Marking customers for targeted outreach: AcmeAnalytics, StreamlineAI.

eng-runtime-bot: captured snapshot of in-flight KV cache sizes and queue distribution: queues_shard_3 = 790, queues_shard_4 = 410, avg_tokens_waiting = 18.

kevin: manual on-demand instances started: 3 x a2-standard fired but one failed to attach due to subnet IP exhaustion. Cloud support responding.

samir: cloud reply: increased IP quota for subnet + temporary on-demand quota for next 30m. Launching 4 more nodes now.

maria: good. keep throttles in place until queues drop below 200. Samir, once new nodes are healthy, please flip fallback_min=4 and set autoscaler retry backoff to longer windows to avoid API rate limits.

sasha: will patch autoscaler config:```autoscaler:
  max_unavailable: 1
  launch_rate_limit: 5/min
  retry_backoff: 45s
  fallback_min_size: 4
```

kevin: queues_down: 1200 -> 450 over 8m after on-demand + throttles. latency p95 decreased to 1m05s and p50 to 180ms. Still watching p99.

maria: thanks. moving to incident handoff. I'm handing this to night oncall @jen for monitoring and follow-ups. Summary for Jen: cause = sudden spike in spot preemptions combined with autoscaler hitting cloud API rate limits + subnet IP quota exhaustion; impact = noisy latency increases, ~4 customer timeouts, degraded p99 for /generate; mitigations applied = paused background jobs, reduced batch sizes, emergency on-demand backfill (+cloud quota bump), increased fallback_min to 4, autoscaler rate limit tuning.

jen: taking over. I'll keep the bridge open and start a postmortem doc. tagging SRE/ML infra for root cause once stable. Any outstanding items?

maria: please add customer outreach notes and set follow-up for: (1) autoscaler backoff tuning in prod, (2) increase permanent reserved fallback capacity for usw2, (3) test simulated preemptions during load tests. Also mark any related runbooks that need updates.

jen: noted. I'll create a tracking ticket and assign follow-ups. Leaving monitoring alerts at reduced threshold for 3h.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress -> transferring to oncall (jen). Severity downgraded to P2 for watch.

maria: thanks team. short post-incident checklist: collect autoscaler logs (kevin), cloud support transcript (samir), preempt metrics (sasha), customer impact list (jen). We'll sync tomorrow for RCA. :thumbsup:
